title: Past Tense: Passato Prossimo with Avere

blocks.markdown:
**Passato prossimo** (the everyday past tense) is formed with the present tense of **avere** or **essere** plus a **past participle**. Most verbs use **avere**. Regular past participles: **-are → -ato** (parlare → parl**ato**), **-ere → -uto** (potere → pot**uto**), **-ire → -ito** (dormire → dorm**ito**).

*Ho mangiato la pizza* (I ate pizza). *Hai parlato con lui?* (Did you talk to him?). The participle doesn't change for gender/number with avere.

exercises.prompt: Ieri io ho ___ la pizza. (mangiare — past participle)
Noi abbiamo ___ italiano per due anni. (studiare — We studied Italian for two years.)
